items.headline: Air India faces ₹22,000 crore loss: Tata Sons Board reviews airline's performance ahead of crucial meeting
items.summary: Tata Sons leaders reviewed Air India’s financial and operational challenges ahead of a board meeting. The airline lost more than ₹22,000 crore in FY2025-26, with fuel costs, airspace restrictions and aircraft delays adding pressure.

items.summary: Aviation watchdog DGCA has issued a show cause notice to crisis-hit SpiceJet seeking detailed responses on rising flight cancellations, operational disruptions due to delayed payments and certain violations, according to sources. The budget carrier, which saw…

items.headline: SpiceJet's ₹5,500-cr fundraise: Can it revive the airline's operations?
items.summary: The proposed ₹5,500-crore raise follows a sharp drop in market share, grounded aircraft and unpaid dues, raising questions about whether fresh capital can restore SpiceJet's operations

items.headline: SpiceJet faces over 7,600 passenger complaints amid widespread flight cancellations
items.summary: SpiceJet faces 7,674 passenger complaints amid flight cancellations, DGCA scrutiny and a cash crunch as the airline operates around 10 aircraft.

items.headline: AI is giving hackers a head start. What's at risk for essential services?

items.headline: JPMorgan reports cyberattack on third-party vendors, customer data potentially exposed
items.summary: JPMorgan reports a cyberattack on third-party vendors, with reports saying email addresses and phone numbers of around 16,000 wealthy customers were exposed.

items.headline: IndiGo expands Southeast Asia flights from Delhi ahead of year-end holidays
items.summary: The airline will launch daily non-stop flights to Kuala Lumpur from December 20, while increasing frequencies on Delhi-Singapore and Delhi-Bangkok routes from December 20 and 28, respectively

items.headline: India's air safety radar picks up gaps in ageing ATC automation systems
items.summary: Delays in ATC modernisation, concerns over commercial TV screens and regulatory hurdles raise questions about India's air traffic management infrastructure

items.headline: Gwalior telecom manufacturing zone draws ₹3,600 cr investment proposals

items.headline: Weak rural indicators clouds second half outlook: BNP Paribas India
items.summary: BNP Paribas India cautions weak rural indicators and slower growth in H2 amid El Niño, inflation, and soft consumption, despite some relief from lower crude prices and robust credit.

items.headline: Amid widening losses, Air India pitches cost cuts to Tata Sons Board

items.summary: SpiceJet cancelled 31 of 42 scheduled flights at Delhi, Mumbai and Bengaluru airports amid mounting financial stress, unpaid dues and operational difficulties.

items.headline: IndiGo expands South East Asia connectivity
items.summary: Daily Delhi-Kuala Lumpur from December 20; expansion amid free e-visas for ASEAN citizens

items.headline: Tata Sons board reviews Air India performance amid mounting losses
items.summary: Tata Sons Chairman N Chandrasekaran and Noel Tata reviewed Air India's performance ahead of the airline's board meeting, where cost cuts and integration plans are likely to be discussed.

items.headline: India’s top 10 brands lose collective value as Airtel claims top spot, Meesho rises fastest
items.summary: In its annual ranking of India’s most valuable brands, Kantar said brand value of the top 10 fell collectively by 16%. Telecom provider Airtel claimed the top spot while value e-commerce platform Meesho rose the fastest to claim the 59th spot.

items.headline: India’s crude oil demand to grow at 3% annually till 2035: IEA
items.summary: Rising transport, aviation, petrochemical and industrial needs are expected to drive India’s oil consumption even as advanced economies see declines.

items.headline: IndiGo cancels all flights to and from Saudi Arabia until November 30
items.summary: IndiGo has cancelled all flights to and from Jeddah, Madinah, Riyadh and Dammam until November 30, citing the security situation in Saudi Arabia.

items.headline: Good news for Dwarka, Najafgarh, Rohini residents! 8 new Delhi Metro corridors proposed under Phase V(B); check routes
items.summary: Delhi Metro Phase V(B) proposals include a corridor linking Yashobhoomi in Dwarka with Rajiv Chowk in Gurugram. Seven of eight proposed routes have Delhi government approval and are awaiting the Centre’s nod.
